text:
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1 to completely check the proper operation and 
calibration of the relay, this procedures must 
be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block. the 
first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates 
required prior to testing.
The first draft initiated by eng. Rasha Soliman, 
tested by eng Mohamed Rabee, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Mohamed Abou Aiasha head sector of Damanhour power station and 
and
certified by eng. 
Gaber Farahat 
WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category
Wear your safety helmet & safety shoes.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Disconnect the DC power supply
Tools and Equipment
ISA test set (secondary 
 injection voltage)
Avometer.
Work to be carried out
Preparation
Review technical reference and manufacture manual.
Obtain a copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and 
 compare it with setting on the relay
Testing 
Procedures
Isolate the secondary terminal of the voltage transformer.
Connect the voltage test set terminals to phase R (1) ,phase S ( 
 2) and phase T (3)
Inject the the three phase voltage (each phase = 50 V) to the 
 relay then decrease the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag for 
 phase R appears then record VR (pick - up)
Increase the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag 
 removed them record VR (reset)
Repeat the steps from 3-4 but to the phase S, T
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Return relay to service by removing the test terminal.
Make sure VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
If any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated, it 
 should be returned to service by the following restoration steps 
 * Breaker trip coils. 
 * Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 * Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with 
 this relay. Make sure VT secondary 
 circuits are in normal condition.
Return the work permit.
